steps.text: explorers-compass: the give lands in the first empty main-inventory slot, which is hotbar 1; right-clicking in the air runs Item.use on the client, which opens the compass screen

explorers-compass: the harness world is created with generateStructures off, so the server's SyncPacket carries no structures and the compass offers none; Tab switches the search target to biomes, whose keys are the dimensions' biome-source biomes
explorers-compass: type the pinyin of 下界荒地 (xia jie huang di), the nether's own biome; the responder runs processSearchTerm, whose textFor(...).contains(term) is the rewritten comparison
